s00-01-story-8b83a7.wav.text: Thirty-two thousand soldiers. And God said, that's too many.

s00-02-story-b3bf9f.wav.text: So he sent most of them home, until there were three hundred left.

s00-03-talk-5d7498.wav.text: Armed with trumpets, clay jars, and torches.

s00-04-pivot-eb274a.wav.text: It sounds like a story about a mighty hero.

s01-01-story-c6a0f6.wav.text: Israel had forgotten God, and for seven years the Midianites ruled over them.

s01-02-story-89e8b9.wav.text: Every harvest, they came, with camels too many to count, and took everything.

s01-03-story-deeb6a.wav.text: Israel hid in caves in the hills.

s01-04-grave-052b77.wav.text: And Israel was brought very low because of Midian.

s01-05-grave-47f3b5.wav.text: And the people of Israel cried out for help to the LORD.

s02-02-story-3f36c7.wav.text: He was threshing his wheat in a winepress, down in a pit, where the raiders wouldn't see him.

s02-03-story-9a456c.wav.text: Then the angel of the LORD appeared under the oak tree, and said this.

s02-04-grave-5623c4.wav.text: The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.

s02-06-story-51d66d.wav.text: Gideon looked around for who he meant.

s02-07-grave-40d078.wav.text: Please, Lord, how can I save Israel?

s02-08-grave-ca9c3a.wav.text: Behold, my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

s03-01-story-3969c2.wav.text: Gideon was still afraid. So he asked God for a sign.

s03-02-story-5a6068.wav.text: He laid a wool fleece on the ground.

s03-03-story-b3024c.wav.text: In the morning, the fleece was soaked with dew, and the ground was dry.

s03-04-story-c2d036.wav.text: Then he asked again, the other way round.

s03-06-talk-2de2f0.wav.text: God was patient with his fear.

s04-01-story-38b3ac.wav.text: Gideon gathered an army. Thirty-two thousand men.

s04-03-grave-2a047b.wav.text: The people with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel boast over me,

s04-04-grave-4cfffb.wav.text: saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

s04-05-story-9cfbd4.wav.text: So everyone who was afraid went home.

s04-06-story-ebb727.wav.text: Ten thousand were left. Still too many.

s04-07-story-1b669e.wav.text: God sent them down to the water, and kept only the three hundred who lapped it from their hands.

s05-01-story-34b6ff.wav.text: Gideon split the three hundred into three groups.

s05-03-story-56465b.wav.text: He gave each man a trumpet, and an empty jar with a torch hidden inside.

s05-04-pivot-125387.wav.text: In the middle of the night, they surrounded the camp.

s06-01-story-ee43c3.wav.text: They blew the trumpets. They smashed the jars.

s06-02-story-980683.wav.text: The torches blazed all round the camp. And they shouted.

s06-03-grave-388d34.wav.text: A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!

s06-04-story-cf5a07.wav.text: The whole camp of Midian woke up in terror, and ran.

s06-05-story-cd21af.wav.text: Not one of the three hundred had to move from his place.

s07-01-pivot-3811d9.wav.text: Afterwards, they wanted to make Gideon king.

s07-02-grave-2b4fc8.wav.text: I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you; the LORD will rule over you.

s07-03-talk-cafadf.wav.text: God didn't need a mighty man.

s07-04-story-bb4a9b.wav.text: He chose a frightened one, and a tiny army, so nobody could say they saved themselves.
